lines.t: Good afternoon, this is Priya from Dravix Finance. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mister Vikram Singh?
Sir, your loan instalment of eight thousand two hundred rupees was due on the fifth and is still pending.
I know. I already told your colleague yesterday that I will pay next week.
Sir, can you please confirm the exact date you will pay?
I told you already, next week. Why do you keep calling me every day?
Sir, I understand, but I need a confirmed date for our records.
This is the third time this week. This is ridiculous, I am really fed up with these calls.
lines.label: frustration

lines.t: Sir, if the payment is late, a penalty will apply.
Look, I lost my job last month and money is tight. I am trying my best.
lines.label: payment_difficulty

lines.t: I see. Can you pay at least part of the amount today?
No, I cannot afford it right now.
